channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: Devon is calling as Richie Anderson helps a retiree from Lincolnshire find her dream home by the sea in a county that already feels like home to her. With beach walks on the wish list, Richie has got just the right properties to show her. Along the way, he meets a couple from London who swapped London life for a slice of Devon heaven and now run a luxurious guest house from their former vicarage.
